en.headline: National Ecology Day exhibition opens at East Kowloon Cultural Centre
en.dek: The Countryside Conservation Office is staging a free show at The Corner until 6 September, with displays on Mirs Bay, conservation and village life.
body: The Countryside Conservation Office under the Environment and Ecology Bureau opened the National Ecology Day Thematic Exhibition 2026 on Tuesday at The Corner, an indoor ground-floor space at the East Kowloon Cultural Centre in Ngau Tau Kok.

The government said the six-day exhibition, which runs until 6 September, is intended to mark the fourth National Ecology Day. It is organised around three themes — Mirs Bay in Hong Kong, nature conservation and village stories — with multimedia displays. One section pairs landscape photographs of Yan Chau Tong taken by Kelvin Yuen with music associated with composer Tan Dun.
Opening hours are 11am to 8pm. Admission is free. The office said the exhibition uses interactive exhibits to introduce countryside culture and habitats and to encourage visits to rural areas.

National Ecology Day has been observed on 15 August each year since 2023. The government and non-governmental groups have scheduled related events from mid-August into late September. Details are listed on the Countryside Conservation Office website.

zh.headline: 全國生態日專題展於東九文化中心展隅免費開放
zh.dek: 鄉郊保育辦事處展覽舉行至9月6日，以大鵬灣、自然保育及鄉村故事為主題，開放時間上午11時至晚上8時。
body: 環境及生態局轄下鄉郊保育辦事處周二起在牛頭角東九文化中心地下室內空間「展隅」舉辦「全國生態日專題展覽2026」。
政府表示，為期6日的展覽舉行至9月6日，以響應第四屆全國生態日，設「香港大鵬灣」、「自然保育」及「鄉村故事」三大主題，並有多媒體互動展區。其中展區結合攝影家袁斯樂在印洲塘拍攝的風景作品，以及與作曲家譚盾相關的樂章。
展覽時間為上午11時至晚上8時，免費入場。鄉郊辦指展覽以互動形式介紹鄉郊文化及自然生境，並鼓勵市民到訪郊區。
國家自2023年起將每年8月15日定為全國生態日。政府及非政府機構由8月中至9月下旬安排一系列相關活動，詳情載於鄉郊辦網站。
